name: mcp-zap-connect
description: Set up or reconnect your local Docker scanner with Claude, then verify its status.
long_description: Provides local prerequisite, setup and readiness tools alongside the existing MCP ZAP Server tools. Ask Claude to set up the scanner; setup reuses the project's published Docker Compose images and bootstrap/doctor scripts. Existing installations and credentials are preserved. Installing the extension does not start Docker or scan targets. Docker installation and operating-system prompts require your interaction. Local macOS preview; native Claude Desktop Free verification is recorded separately from package tests.

tools.name: scanner_check_prerequisites
tools.description: Check local Docker requirements and detect an existing scanner without changing it.

tools.name: scanner_setup
tools.description: After an explicit setup request, reuse the existing scanner or run the bundled bootstrap in a private installation directory.

tools.name: scanner_check_readiness
tools.description: Run the existing authenticated doctor without invoking a scanner tool.

installation_directory.title: Scanner directory (optional)
installation_directory.description: Leave blank to detect the running Docker installation, or use ~/.mcp-zap-server for a new installation. An explicit directory must be an absolute path owned by you.

api_key.title: Scanner API key override (optional)
api_key.description: Usually leave blank: the local connector reads the existing scanner credential privately. An override must match the running installation.
